task.description:
Implement API-01 REST conventions infrastructure per the design in src/design/api_conventions.md.

Files to create:

1. **src/api/errors.zig** — RFC 9457 Problem Details builder
   - ProblemDetails struct with: type ([]const u8), title ([]const u8), status (u16), detail ([]const u8)
   - JSON serialiser: serializeToJson(pd: ProblemDetails, allocator: std.mem.Allocator) []const u8
   - Constructor helpers (all return ProblemDetails, no allocation):
     - problemBadRequest(detail: []const u8) ProblemDetails
     - problemNotFound(detail: []const u8) ProblemDetails
     - problemConflict(detail: []const u8) ProblemDetails
     - problemUnprocessable(detail: []const u8) ProblemDetails
     - problemUnsupportedMediaType() ProblemDetails
     - problemInternalError() ProblemDetails
     - problemServiceUnavailable() ProblemDetails
   - type URI format: "https://bpm.example.com/problems/<slug>" (slug = kebab-case of title)

2. **src/api/middleware/content_type.zig** — Content-Type enforcement
   - checkContentType(method: []const u8, content_type: ?[]const u8, has_body: bool) — returns ?ProblemDetails
   - Returns null if check passes
   - Returns HTTP 415 ProblemDetails if POST/PUT/PATCH with wrong or missing Content-Type: application/json
   - Returns HTTP 400 ProblemDetails if PUT with no body

3. **src/api/response.zig** — HTTP response helper
   - Re-export HandlerResult type (status_code: u16, body: []const u8)
   - ok(allocator, body: []const u8) HandlerResult — HTTP 200
   - created(allocator, body: []const u8) HandlerResult — HTTP 201
   - noContent() HandlerResult — HTTP 204, empty body
   - problemResponse(allocator, pd: ProblemDetails) HandlerResult — serialises ProblemDetails to JSON body

Constraints:
- No SQL or DB changes
- No I/O in any function
- All functions that allocate must accept std.mem.Allocator
- After implementing, update src/main.zig to import the new modules so they are compiled
- Run: zig build (must exit 0)
- Run: zig build test (must exit 0)
- Self-review: no SQL injection risk (no SQL here), pure functions where possible
acceptance_criteria: src/api/errors.zig exists with ProblemDetails struct and all constructor helpers
src/api/response.zig exists with HandlerResult and helper functions
All HTTP verbs for API-01 ACs are handled (415, 400, 200, 201, 204)
RFC 9457 fields present: type, title, status, detail

result.summary: Implemented API-01 REST conventions infrastructure: src/api/errors.zig (RFC 9457 ProblemDetails + 7 constructor helpers + serialise()), src/api/middleware/content_type.zig (checkContentType pure + enforceContentType allocating), src/api/response.zig (HandlerResult canonical type + ok/created/noContent/problemResponse). Updated src/main.zig imports. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
